x: (Photo:Sport & General) Gerry North leads R. Gomez during the Southern '6' at Motspur Park.
Only Ron Gomez could hang on to our Gerry, but even he had to drop back after halfway. If it had not been for a bout of stomach cramp in the last mile Gerry might well have beaten 28:20.
On July 6th at Stockwood Park, Luton he won the 45-49 age group 5000 metres in 15:22.0. from Aylesbury's Ron Gomez to win the Southern Vets title.
